Scenario fixture: textbox-name-present (role="textbox" must have an accessible name)

Each target element has a stable id of the form textbox_case_NN. role="textbox" is name-from-author-only: aria-label, aria-labelledby, title, and native <label> association are valid; subtree content is NOT a valid name source.

A. Baseline: mechanism priority order (eligible)

01 — FAIL: no name at all
02 — FAIL: visible text content only (author-only-name: content does NOT count)
Search
03 — PASS: aria-label
04 — PASS: aria-labelledby (external reference)
Site search
05 — PASS: title
06 — PASS: native <label for> association (input role=textbox)
07 — PASS: wrapping <label>
08 — FAIL: aria-label empty string
Visible text ignored
09 — FAIL: aria-labelledby references non-existent id
10 — FAIL: whitespace-only aria-label

B. Visible but excluded from AT (ineligible)

11 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: aria-hidden="true", not focusable, missing name
12 — EXCEPTION: aria-hidden="true" but focusable (tabindex=0) => eligible, missing name => FAIL
13 — EXCEPTION: aria-hidden="true" but IDREF-referenced => eligible, missing name => FAIL
This references the textbox below by id.

C. Hidden by HTML/CSS (ineligible)

14 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: hidden attribute
15 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: display:none
16 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: visibility:hidden
17 — EXCEPTION: visibility:hidden ancestor overridden by descendant visibility:visible => eligible, missing name => FAIL

D. Inertness (ineligible)

18 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: inert on element itself
19 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: inert ancestor

E. Non-composed content (ineligible)

20 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: inside closed <details>
More
21 — NEUTRAL/INELIGIBLE: inside <template> (not composed)

F. Native label fallbacks on a non-natively-labelable element (no .labels API)

22 — PASS: wrapping <label> around a role="textbox" element that has no native .labels API (closest('label') fallback)
23 — PASS: label[for] on a non-natively-labelable element; the label's own content is empty, so its name falls back to its title attribute

End of fixture.
